tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs bzhugs/

na mo he badz+ra ḍā kā ya/ 'dir dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig la phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs bya bar 'dod na/ rang bdag bskyed sgom tshul zur du gsal ba bzhin sgom bzlas byas nas/ rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa la ring du mnyam par 'jog de nas mdun du mchod pa'i rten he ru ka'i sku brnyan nam/ ma rnyed na/ dri bzang gi thig le bkod kyang rung ste/ de'i mdun du gtor ma/ mtha' skor du mchod pa rnam lnga chu bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mdun du dbang gi chu/ rgyab tu dag byed kyi chu snod/ g.yon du chang snod bcud kyis gang ba*/ sa'i mthil du bhe ra ba mchod pa'i gtor ma gnyis/ rwa'am/ bya nag mo'i gzugs bag zan la bcos pa'i nang khrag btsos pa dang ma btsos pa'i bkang ba gnyis/ ma dā na dang*/ rak+ta'i ar+ghaṃ dang bcas pa bshams la/ oṃ ghaṃ badz+ra ghasma rī hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun nam/ drag po gdan can lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis dgug gzhug bcings mnyes pas rten dang gnyis su med par thim/ de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ha ho hrīḥlas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ de nas/ oṃ nai ri te hūṃ khaṃ zhes sogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ a kā ro'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgyas gtor ma phul/ yang yi ge 'bru gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po thams cad bkug ste/ oṃ in+d+ra sogs kyis phul/ 'dod pa'i don sgrub par gsol ba btab/ de nas dbang gi chu dang*/ dag byed kyi chu la rtsa ba'i sngags lan bzhi brgyar bzlas la/ phai+eṃ lan brgyad kyi nga ro stangs stabs dang bcas te byas nas/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ myos byed la phog pas/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bdud rtsir spyan drangs te stims pas/ rgya cher spel bar bsam nas phai+eṃ sgra drag po brgya rtsa tsam dang*/ hūṃ gi sna glu dang*/ kha dang lkog mar nyed pa lan brgya tsam byas rjes/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag/de nas bhai ra ba ma mo dang bcas par gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ khrag gam/ khrag tu brdzus pas sa rjen la/ chag chag btab/ oṃ bi ma la badz+ra bhu mi/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dmar po/ khrag chen rnams bsres pas rkyang nul byas la/ badz+ra puṣ+taṃ ku ru/ de nas me tog nag po'am/ 'bru nag po blangs la/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu 'god cing*/ mahā bhai ra ba ā ya na maḥ sid+dha pa ṇa bhai ra ba= swa na ri= sh+ya ri= ka pi la= bi ka ṭa= kā la= mahā yo ga= de nas khrag gi thig le phyogs mtshams brgyad du byas la/ prah+mi= rau drī= kau ma rī= na ra ya ṇī= wā rā hī= badz+ra haste= kā la rā trī= tsa mūn+ṭi ā ya na maḥ zhes brjod pas/ 'jigs byed dgu/ ma mo brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros bhai ra ba ma mo brgyad dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ a kar+ṣa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ bh+yaḥbarta lī gnyis tsheḥzhes pas 'khod par gyur pa ni/ dbus su bhai ra ba lag pa bcu gar byed pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thod khrag gri gug ḍā ma ru/ rtse gsum bsnams pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams gri rgu po dang*/ chang snod 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed brgyad po gri gug dang*/ chang snod bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang byis pa'i gzugs can khro zhing gtum pas sha khrag la dgyes pa/ ma mo brgyad po rnams rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can skra grol ba/ thams cad kyang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de nas mchod gtor yi ge 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir ltas la/

kha kha k+ṣi zhes sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ ma dā na dang*/ dmar gyi arga lha so so'i ming dang spel nas/ oṃ ma rā na ar+gha na maḥdang*/ oṃ mahā rak+ta arga na maḥzhes phul nas/ gu gul gyis bdug pas bdug cing*/ bhai ra ba ā ya na maḥnas/ bhai ra pa ti ri pa ga ti'i bar sngags brgya rtsa dang*/ kha kha sogs brgya brgya bzla/ de nas bya'am ra'i gzugs kyi mgrin pa bcad pa'i nang gi khrag gis gtor zhing*/ dum bu rnams lha so so'i gnas su bzhag la/ oṃ ki li sogs bzla/ de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma la/ ma dā na dang*/ khrag gi lhag ma blug cing*/ dri bzang gi chu dang*/ myos byed kyi arga 'gro phyogs su bsgreng ba dang bcas/ oṃ ku ru sogs dang*/ bh+yaḥsogs kyi sngags kyis puk+ka sī spyan drangs nas mdun du 'khod pa ni/ sku mdog ser skya/ phyag dang po gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu/ bong bu la zhon pa sgom nas/ kī li sogs dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs nas/ a kā ros yul la 'phrin las bcol te/ gtor ma bzhi mdor dor/ de nas slob ma gang yin rang gi mdun du bzhag ste/ maṇ+ḍal lan gcig 'bul du bcug la/ yang maṇ+ḍal bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra bhu me swahā/ skyon sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra su re khe hūṃ/ rkyang nul bya/ de'i dbus su hū/ su me ru ma dhe ma/ ya pū rbi de haḥdī pa/ ra dzam+bu dī pa dak+ṣi ṇa/ ba go dwa ni ya pa tsi ma dwi pa/ la ut+ta ra ku ru dwi pa/ yaṃ yaḥde ha sh+tsa bi de haḥraṃ raḥ tsa ma ra sh+tsa a pa ra tsā ma raḥbaṃ baḥ sha ṣā sh+tsa ut+ta ra/ man+ti ṇaḥ laṃ laḥkur bash+tsa kau ra bā/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya bhu ṣi ta zhes tshom bu bkod la phul nas/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ / sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes lan gsum du bstod nas/ bdag gi bde ba dang sdug bsngal khyod kyis mkhyen no/ /bde yang rung*/

sdug bsngal yang rung*/ khyed las gzhan ma mchis so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas/ brtan g.yo thams cad 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du sbyangs/ shu n+ya ta brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las e waṃ nas/ bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ 'dir khyad par ni/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dpa' gcig dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa 'god pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe dbang gi chu bos spyi bo nas blugs cing 'khrud pa dang*/ bzlas lung gi tshe/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ yig la bstim pas/ de'i rkyen gyis nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor sogs grub nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa bsgom du bcug la/ rtsa sngags lan gcig dang*/ snying po lan gsum rig byed klog pa lta bur rjes zlos byed du gzhug pa rnams yin no/ /de nas/ dag byed kyi chu la mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg ste/ g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor nas/ oṃ dza la sa t+yaṃ sogs lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs/ tru sta gad+ge sogs kyis khrus byed du gzhugabi bhū ti'i thal chen dza bāṇ+ta'i sngags kyi chu la sbyangs nas/ ā de zhes sogs kyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug cing*/ de nas dpral mgrin snying ga dpung pa 'khrig ma rnams su/ sor ris gsum gyis tri maṇ+ḍal la bya/ de nas sngar bzhin bhai ra ba 'khor bcas la gtor ma phul/ lhag gtor btang*/ slob ma'i rgyud la phyag rgya bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ slob ma'i nang gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul te ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa lag tu byung*/ de'i rang lus dum bur byas nas 'god par bya ste/ hūṃ mastaka su me ru ya bā ma bād bi de ha/

rad hi na pā da dzam+bu dwi pa/ bash+tsa ma dwi pa da hi na hasta/ la pā maha sta ku ru at+ta ra/ shu kra ku su ma tsan+d+ra sur+ya bhu ṣi taṃ zhes so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams la rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa dang po phog la/ mgo bor me tog dang bcas pa'i lag pa byin te/ oṃ tsa tur mu dra sid+dha bhā wan+tu zhes brjod/ de nas slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha nye bar bsdus te/ las rjes mi mngon par byas la/ ci bde bar bya ba ni byin rlabs kyi tshul lo// //shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos brjed byang du'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ /zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs bzhugs/ - PAGE 240 -- PAGE 239 -- PAGE 236 -
